data.name: Send document for signature
data.description: This will help you to send a document to your recipients for signature.
data.evaluateGuide:
Submits a prepared signature resource so its document can be sent to recipients for signing.
Use for: send a document for signing, notify recipients, start a signature workflow
Not supported: drafting documents, retrieving signature status, downloading completed files

data.name: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure.
data.description: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with HTML formatting, for the requested envelope recipient. This might be different than the current account disclosure depending on account settings, such as branding, and when the account disclosure was last updated. An optional query string can be included to return the language for the disclosure.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the HTML electronic record and signature disclosure for a specified envelope recipient, optionally in a chosen language.
Use for: display recipient disclosure, retrieve disclosure HTML, localize disclosure language
Not supported: sending envelopes, managing recipients, retrieving signed documents

data.name: 18. Send Envelope with Template
data.description: Send an envelop with a single template.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates and sends an envelope using one template, allowing a template-based signing workflow to begin.
Use for: send a template envelope, start signature collection, initiate a signing workflow
Not supported: editing templates, retrieving envelope status, downloading signed files

data.name: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure for the account.
data.description: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with HTML formatting, associated with the account. You can use an optional query string to set the language for the disclosure.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the account-level HTML electronic record and signature disclosure, optionally in a specified language.
Use for: retrieve account disclosure, display disclosure HTML, select disclosure language
Not supported: recipient-specific disclosure, sending envelopes, managing signatures

data.name: Send document out for signature using templates
data.description: In order to use the template, the recipient details need to be given. In previous call the actions array contains number of recipients. It may or may not have an email address. When using the template, the actions need to be sent along with email id and name for all. Number of actions cannot be changed. In case there are document fields to be filled (documentfields array) then the value for those also needs to be filled. If the “ismandatory” is true for a field then it must have a value. Else value ne
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a signing document from an existing template with recipient details and required field values, preparing it to be sent for signature.
Use for: create from template, assign recipients, populate document fields
Not supported: sending the signing document, creating templates, retrieving completed files

data.name: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure associated with the account.
data.description: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with html formatting, associated with the account. You can use an optional query string to set the language for the disclosure.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the HTML electronic record and signature disclosure for a recipient within a specific envelope, optionally in a chosen language.
Use for: retrieve recipient disclosure, display envelope disclosure, localize disclosure HTML
Not supported: sending envelopes, changing recipients, downloading signed documents

data.name: Adds a document to an existing draft envelope.
data.description: Adds a document to an existing draft envelope.
data.evaluateGuide:
Adds or replaces a document in an existing draft envelope.
Use for: add a draft document, update envelope contents, prepare an envelope
Not supported: sending the envelope, editing recipient roles, retrieving signed files

data.name: Reserved: Gets the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure associated with the account.
data.description: Reserved: Retrieves the Electronic Record and Signature Disclosure, with HTML formatting, associated with the account.
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves the HTML electronic record and signature disclosure for a recipient in a specific envelope, with an optional language value.
Use for: retrieve recipient disclosure, display disclosure HTML, select disclosure language
Not supported: sending envelopes, modifying recipients, downloading signed documents

data.name: Adds a document to a template document.
data.description: Adds the specified document to an existing template document.
data.evaluateGuide:
Adds a document to an existing template document, optionally treating it as an envelope definition.
Use for: add a template document, update template contents, prepare template materials
Not supported: sending envelopes, managing recipients, retrieving signed files

data.name: Upload an original
data.description: Easily import documents from your local machine onto Signeasy in order to request them for e-signatures.
data.evaluateGuide:
Uploads an original document to Signeasy so it can be prepared for electronic signatures.
Use for: upload a document, import a local file, prepare a signing document
Not supported: sending for signature, adding recipients, retrieving signature status

meta.q: send a document for electronic signature
